text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: For today's main race, accompanied by a cool autumn breeze, the Umamusume vying for the queen's throne have assembled.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Vodka was scratched due to poor condition.
Who will claim the queen's crown this year—?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... No way~. And here I thought
I'd get to see Vodka run~...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: I was the first favorite until yesterday, after all... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's with that "Queen Elizabeth II Cup is
just around the corner... I'll be waiting there" nonsense?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You didn't wait for me at all!
Ugh, seriously, that's so annoying!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But the ones who tick me off the most are them!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The crowd, I mean the crowd!!
Hype about someone who's not even here, like "Vodka did this"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"And to think *I'm* the one running!
Jeez~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll make them all realize who's running in this Queen Elizabeth II Cup
with my own running!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
With a dazzling run so memorable,
it'll make you completely forget about Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not letting anyone who isn't running take center stage.
The one who's gonna be number one is me!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everything she wanted from this race,
I'm gonna take it all for myself!!
